title: Animated Swearing World Cup
methodology_note: Subreddit-identity fanbase ranking. Qualified teams meet the minimum sample; low-sample teams are shown but unranked.

awards.label: Golden Ball
awards.eligibility_note: Highest swear hits per 1,000 words among qualified teams.

awards.label: Golden Glove
awards.eligibility_note: Lowest swear hits per 1,000 words among qualified teams.

awards.label: Fair Play Award
awards.eligibility_note: Lowest swear hits per 100 comments among qualified teams.

awards.label: Breakthrough Award
awards.eligibility_note: Highest swear hits per 1,000 words among low-sample teams; unranked.

awards.label: Passion Index
awards.eligibility_note: Enabled only when data/context/country_population.json is present.

awards.label: Top Swear Match
awards.eligibility_note: Highest match-level swear hits per 1,000 words across scored comments.

awards.label: Top Swear Word
awards.eligibility_note: Most frequent exact lexicon swear token across scored comments.
